title: Which one fails?
examObjective: Applying correct syntax to write DataWeave transformations to coerce, format, order, and filter data
prompt: Three of these run. **One fails.** Which one?

options:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload.n match { case n if n > 3 -> "big" else -> "small" }

%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
if (payload.n > 9) "huge" else if (payload.n > 3) "big" else "small"

explanation.approach: An `if` in DataWeave is an expression, and an expression always needs a value. Without `else` there is no value for the false case, so the script does not compile.

snippets.label: The one that fails
snippets.note: Missing Else, even though the condition is true for this payload.

snippets.label: Chained else if
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
if (payload.n > 9) "huge" else if (payload.n > 3) "big" else "small"
